newsitem.title: INDIA: India Larsen undecided on steel venture.
newsitem.headline: India Larsen undecided on steel venture.

text.p: Indian engineering and construction firm Larsen & Toubro Ltd is undecided about a proposal to venture into steel making, its chairman said.

"We are still examining the steel project and a major interest on the project is from the point of view of securing EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) work," its chairman S.D. Kulkarni told a news conference on Thursday.
"We have done considerable work on the project," he said.
The company's plan to enter steel making had been criticised by several securities firms as a misdirected diversification for a construction and engineering company.
